title: Pyare Nabi ka Pyara
body:
pyare nabi ka pyara nawasa
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
<<DIVIDER>>
darya kanare do din ka pyasa
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ye karbala ki mehman nawazi
ye kufiyon ki hangama saazi
aisa mujahid aisa namazi
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein yasrab se aa ke
bhatke huwon ko rasta bata ke
insaniyat ka paigham laa ke
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek wafa ke paikar ko le kar
akbar ko le kar asghar ko le kar
humraah apne ghar bhar ko le kar
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hal ataa ke ghar ka ujaala
jo la fataah ki godhi ka paala
taqdees waala tatheer waala
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehre ke kaisi tabindagi hai
mazloomiyat ki paaindagi hai
laashe se paida kya zindagi hai
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram ke dil hai niraale
baithe huwe hai kya gham sambhale
ab reh gaye hai sab rone waale
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
basti se keh do sehra se keh do
khushki se keh do darya se keh do
mazloom hai wo dunya se keh do
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay najm dekho ye haq numeini
allah is ke gham ki rasaayi
bardaasht na hai saari khudaai
maara gaya hai raahe khuda mein
pyare nabi ka...
author: Najm Afandi
